items.name: Giày Huyết Ma
items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE square BACKROOMS inventory equipment icon. Both supplied images are exact STYLE / SET REFERENCES: Huyet Ma sword and Huyet Ma armor. Match their premium detailed non-pixel 3D fantasy game item illustration, centered single equipment set in a rounded square liquid-glass tile with slim luminous beveled corners, full rich GOLD / ORANGE / AMBER glass background with flowing golden refraction, dark amber corner vignette, dramatic miniature product lighting and crisp silhouette at 128x128. Equipment must belong to the SAME HUYET MA armor set: deep blood-crimson red armor plates, blackened steel / dark leather joints, intricate antique-gold trim, angular pointed flanges and restrained glowing crimson inlays. Keep equipment color distinct from golden background. Complete objects occupy about 78% of tile and remain fully INSIDE its glass border with padding. No text, letters, watermark, logo, character, human limbs, UI, mint or green background, flat/vector style, cartoon or pixel art. One icon only, not a sheet. Subject: ONE matching PAIR of empty heavy Huyet Ma WAR BOOTS / battle greaves, calf-high layered crimson and black metal armor, angular knee/shin plates, antique-gold edge trim, armored articulated toe plates and sturdy soles. Both whole boots visible, one slightly behind the other in a three-quarter product view. No legs, no cape, no other armor pieces. Visually derive their plate shapes and detailing from the supplied Huyet Ma torso armor.
